notes: Complete list: 51 distinct action ids and no feedbacks (the module registers no feedback definitions). The action set depends on the config option "model" (carbonite = Carbonite/Graphite, default; acuity = Acuity/Vision; ultrix; videoserver = Ross Video Server Mira/Tria/Kiva; opengear): GetActionDefinitions() in src/actions/index.ts picks one model file and adds gpi, gpiByName (not for videoserver) and custom for every model. Each entry carries an availability note naming the models and file:line; the definitions are rebuilt on every configUpdated (src/main.ts:35-37).

Merged entries: ids that several models register with different options are one entry here (cut, autotrans, transRate, transType, transIncl, xpt, transKey, ftb, loadset, saveset, MEM, memSave, MVBOX, mnem, cc, gpi). The option list is the union; options that exist on one model only say so in their description. Defaults that differ per model (mle, xpt vidDest, MEM memID) are given for the default model carbonite and the other value is stated in the description. The validator cannot check per model, so it accepts the union.

Provenance points to the carbonite registration where the id exists on carbonite (the shared helpers live in src/actions/shared.ts, the field helpers in src/actions/fields.ts), otherwise to the model file that registers it.

Field helpers (src/actions/fields.ts): numberField = number, asInteger, max 9999 (integer: true, max: 9999 in the catalog); textField = textinput with useVariables; videoField = dropdown with allowCustom (free text allowed, the choices are suggestions); dropdownField = dropdown with disableAutoExpression; expressionDropdownField = plain dropdown that may be switched to an expression (Companion skips the action when the expression result is not one of the choices); onOffField = expressionDropdownField with ON/OFF.

Large generated lists (source, destination and MLE dropdowns) are described in choicesNote instead of being enumerated; the lists come from src/choices.ts. Labels there have the form "<name> (<id>)". Regex.NUMBER is /^\d+$/ (verified in @companion-module/base 2.2.1, the repo pins ~2.1.3).

Protocol: RossTalk text commands over TCP (config default port 7788, optional "TCP Keep Alive" single connection). Every command is a single line; see src/commands.ts for the command strings. Presets (src/presets.ts) and variables are not catalogued.
The option "tooltip" texts of the source are copied into the option description as "Tooltip: ...".
Built on @companion-module/base ~2.1.3: option values may be expressions except for options with disableAutoExpression (dropdownField fields, the multidropdown "keys" of transIncl).
